findings.correction: Keep the three Level up! lines, then a continuation mark (ellipsis or extra Level up! lines) before the cumulative-heal notice.
findings.current:
- Level up!
> - Level up!
> - Level up!
> - All status ailments have been cured by the cumulative effect of the level-ups!
findings.defect: The source’s `. .` after three notices marks further consecutive level-ups before the stack-heal line; the draft presents exactly three.
findings.rationale: Quantity and System presentation: 중첩 효과 follows an indicated run of additional level-ups, not a closed set of three.

findings.correction: Just think of it as a senile old man’s shit-fit.
findings.current: Just think of it as a senile old man’s tantrum.
findings.defect: 지랄 is vulgar self-abuse; tantrum sanitizes the Head Elder’s register.
findings.rationale: Profanity should match source strength; the dying elder is crude, not merely peevish.

findings.correction: Keep Gunggwimun and add a first-use footnote: 弓鬼門, lit. Bow Ghost Gate.
findings.current: The Sect Leader of Gunggwimun, Jin Chung
findings.defect: First appearance of an unlisted sect name with explanatory hanja, romanized with no footnote.
findings.rationale: Binding terminology: first unlisted name/title almost always needs a footnote or mapped term; 진충 as Jin Chung is fine.

findings.correction: He was the wastrel Third Young Master who had never even been called an earth dragon.
findings.current: He was the wastrel Third Young Master who had never even been worthy of being called an earth dragon.
findings.defect: 소리도 못 듣던 is that he never even heard himself called 토룡; worthy of is an added judgment.
findings.rationale: Adds a worthiness claim the Korean does not make; the contrast is epithet never applied, not desert.
findings.source: 토룡(土龍) 소리도 못 듣던 망나니 삼공자다.

findings.defect: Singular address to the speaking martial artist is rendered as plural fools.
findings.rationale: Subject/number: 이놈 targets the one disciple, not the group.

findings.defect: Subordinate command-acknowledgment flattened to a peer-neutral reply.
findings.rationale: 존명 marks hierarchy to the disguised martial artist; Understood loses that cue.

findings.defect: The death rattle is split into a second spoken line.
findings.rationale: One broken utterance, not a new line of dialogue.

summary: Major register softening of 지랄 and omitted stacked level-up continuation understate quantity/tone; first-use 궁귀문 lacks a footnote; a few subject, judgment, and hierarchy nits.
